item.title: Apache Axis2/Java 2.0.1: CVE-2026-123770 and CVE-2026-123766
item.description:
Posted by Apache Security Team on Nov 06

Apache Axis2/Java 2.0.1 fixes two issues:

CVE-2026-123770: Unbounded multipart and form-encoded request bodies
CVE-2026-123766: Cross-site scripting in the OpenAPI module's Swagger UI page
